_comment: ANHONI story seeds — original everyday-India-turns-eerie premises built on the proven viral horror/suspense playbook (see story_gen.PLAYBOOK). Patterns only, not copied stories. Fiction, policy-safe: NO gore/graphic. Date-rotated, one per day.
seeds: Ek PG warden ki WhatsApp aati hai 'gate lock ho gaya, andar aa jao' — par wo pichhle mahine gujar chuki hai; uska number aaj bhi nayi ladkiyon ko text karta hai.
Night-shift cab driver ko roz 2 baje wahi ek sawaari milti hai jo har baar wahi address bolti hai — wahi mod jahan uski pichhli sawaari gayab ho gayi thi.
Rishte ke liye aaye ladke ke parivaar ki har purani photo me ek extra aadmi khada hai, jise parivaar kehta hai kabhi paida hi nahi hua.
Joint family ki badi bahu roz 9 logon ka khaana banati hai jabki ghar me 8 hi hain; 9vi plate subah tak khaali mil jaati hai.
Society ke watchman ke register me ek flat ka visitor roz raat ko andar aata hai — signature karta hai, par bahar jaate hue kabhi sign nahi karta.
Hostel ki roommate sirf load-shedding me dikhti hai; jaise hi inverter chalta hai, uska bistar khaali aur banaa-banaaya milta hai.
Ek dulhan ki mehndi raat bhar me gehri hoke ek naam ban jaati hai — us aurat ka naam jise sasural walon ne kabhi zikr nahi kiya.
Building ki chhat ka paani ka tanki sirf us raat overflow hota hai jab building me kisi ki maut hone wali hoti hai; poori gali jaanti hai kiski light jali dekhni hai.
Raat 3:33 baje apne hi number se missed call aati hai, aur recent calls me dikhta hai ki main hafte bhar se khud ko hi call kar raha hoon.
Ek naukrani jo parivaar ke saath 'barson' se hai — par har purane album me har dashak me wo bilkul usi umar ki dikhti hai.
Karva Chauth par ek aurat chhalni me pati ka chehra dekhti hai, par pati toh factory ki night shift pe hai — aur factory se call aata hai ki wo aaj aaya hi nahi.
Naye flat me shift hote hi har raat 3 baje ek bachche ke rone ki aawaz aati hai; par is ghar me kabhi koi bachcha nahi tha.
Ek aadmi ko roz ek anjaan number se apni hi aane wali ghatnaon ke message aate hain; aaj wale message me uski aaj ki maut likhi hai.
Office ki night shift me lift har baar 4th floor pe apne aap rukti hai, jabki 4th floor 6 saal se band pada hai.
Ek nurse ki night duty; room 302 ka mareez roz mar jaata hai aur agli raat phir wahi zinda baitha milta hai.
Purane gaon lautne par ek aadmi ko sab pehchante hain, par wo kisi ko nahi; sab kehte hain wo 10 saal pehle yahin se ja chuka tha.
Ek ladki ki nayi flatmate bilkul usi jaisi dikhti hai, usi jaisi baat karti hai — aur dheere dheere uski zindagi apne naam kar rahi hai.
Ek shaks ko roz subah darwaze par ek nayi tasveer milti hai — kal raat ki, uski khud ki, sote hue.
Aadhi raat, cab me akeli ladki; driver baar-baar peeche dekhta hai aur kehta hai 'is sadak pe kisi ko mat rok'na'.
Peepal ke ped wale mod par har Amavasya ko ek chadar bichhi milti hai jispe ek naam likha hota hai — agle din wahi aadmi gayab ho jaata hai.
